details: yardxabc889 0.0.1 (2026-05-12). Its .yardopts uses --load to run evil.rb when YARD builds the gem's documentation, which gave the publisher code execution on RubyDoc.info's documentation build workers. The script fetches a remote page, writes it into the gem's README, then rewrites .yardopts to remove the --load line ("disable evil in next version and bump version") and publishes the result as 0.0.2 with an embedded API key. Documented in the rubyhack.ai research by Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen and Sydney Von Arx (2026-09-11). The gem has been removed from RubyGems.
